verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a first-party, full-account export in open formats. Only adjacent items appear: REST API and MCP CRUD access (developer building blocks), spreadsheet sync in Advanced, and backup-and-restore to undo mistakes. None of these is an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
